description: Ministry of Youth & Sports - Amendment relevance to the 2020 : the National Association of Sports Regulations
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Sports under the Sports Law No. 25 of 1973, specifically amending previous regulations related to the constitution of National Associations/Federations of Sports. The content focuses on legal/regulatory amendments to existing sports regulations, which falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and modifications to regulatory frameworks.
